cases.sentence: Возьмите ковчег Господа и поставьте его на повозку, а ___, которые вы принесете Ему как жертву повинности, положите в ящик около ковчега.
cases.explain: «золотые предметы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: and take Yahweh’s ark and lay it on the cart. Put the jewels of gold, which you return him for a trespass offering, in a box by its side; and send it away, that it may go.

cases.sentence: Поставили ковчег Господа на повозку вместе с ящиком, в котором были ___ и изображения наростов.
cases.explain: «золотые мыши» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They put Yahweh’s ark on the cart, and the box with the golden mice and the images of their tumors.

cases.sentence: Филистимские правители следовали за ними до ___ Бет-Шемеша.
cases.explain: «самой границы» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The cows took the straight way by the way to Beth Shemesh. They went along the highway, lowing as they went, and didn’t turn away to the right hand or to the left; and the lords of the Philistines went after them to the border of Beth Shemesh.

cases.sentence: Повозка приехала на поле Иисуса из Бет-Шемеша и остановилась там возле ___.
cases.explain: «большого камня» — after the preposition «возле», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The cart came into the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh, and stood there, where there was a great stone. Then they split the wood of the cart and offered up the cows for a burnt offering to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Левиты сняли ковчег Господа вместе с ящиком, в котором были ___, и поставили их на большой камень.
cases.explain: «золотые предметы» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: The Levites took down Yahweh’s ark and the box that was with it, in which the jewels of gold were, and put them on the great stone; and the men of Beth Shemesh offered burnt offerings and sacrificed sacrifices the same day to Yahweh.

cases.sentence: Пять ___ увидели все это и в тот же день вернулись в Экрон.
cases.explain: «филистимских правителей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When the five lords of the Philistines had seen it, they returned to Ekron the same day.

cases.sentence: ___ филистимляне послали как жертву повинности Господу − по одному за Ашдод, Газу, Ашкелон, Гат и Экрон.
cases.explain: «Золотые наросты» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: These are the golden tumors which the Philistines returned for a trespass offering to Yahweh: for Ashdod one, for Gaza one, for Ashkelon one, for Gath one, for Ekron one;

cases.sentence: А число ___ соответствовало числу городов, принадлежащих филистимским правителям, − укрепленных городов с пригородными поселениями.
cases.explain: «золотых мышей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

cases.sentence: А число золотых мышей соответствовало числу городов, принадлежащих ___, − укрепленных городов с пригородными поселениями.
cases.explain: «филистимским правителям» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

cases.sentence: А число золотых мышей соответствовало числу городов, принадлежащих филистимским правителям, − укрепленных городов с ___.
cases.explain: «пригородными поселениями» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.

cases.sentence: Большой камень, на который поставили ковчег Господа, — до ___ стоит на поле Иисуса из Бет-Шемеша как свидетельство случившегося.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: and the golden mice, according to the number of all the cities of the Philistines belonging to the five lords, both of fortified cities and of country villages, even to the great stone on which they set down Yahweh’s ark. That stone remains to this day in the field of Joshua of Beth Shemesh.
